verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official MCP server, including a hosted option, that MCP-capable agents such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot and Windsurf can connect to. Once connected, agents can manage flags, AgentControl configs and observability data in natural language, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works well in practice.
